card.name: Partway through long compound terms
card.fires_on: Joints inside long compound terms: the 'o' in trichloroethylene, 'yl' in triphenylmethane, 'Related' in Transfusion-Related, and the space before a number like 1 million or 10,000.

modes.label: Inside chemical names
modes.description: A middle piece of a long drug or solvent name, before the rest of the name.

modes.label: After hyphen in Transfusion-Related
modes.description: The word Related in the term Transfusion-Related Acute Lung Injury.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space before a figure in a rate such as 1 in 10,000 or per 1 million.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long compound terms, such as chemical names and a transfusion-lung-injury phrase, and before numbers in rates.
